import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/test_3.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold DataFrames from each source
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV, select only the TrackID column, and append to list
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, usecols=['TrackID'])
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all TrackID columns from all sources
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Drop duplicates to get unique TrackID values
    unique_track_ids = combined_df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)

    # Ensure TrackID is integer type (as per target schema)
    unique_track_ids['TrackID'] = unique_track_ids['TrackID'].astype(int)

    # Save the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_88/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    unique_track_ids.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
